reports.report_text:
There are consolidations in both lungs. The consolidations are more prominent on the right and
tend to coalesce peripherally. There is a mosaic pattern observed in both lungs, with
ground-glass appearances accompanying consolidation areas. No mass or infiltrative lesion was
detected within the borders of non-contrast CT. Mediastinal structures could not be evaluated
optimally because of the lack of contrast agent. Heart contour and size are normal. The widths
of the mediastinal main vascular structures are normal. No pathologically enlarged lymph nodes
were detected in the mediastinum and hilar regions. Trachea and both main bronchi are open.
No occlusive pathology was detected in the trachea and both main bronchial lumens. No upper
abdominal free fluid-collection or pathologically enlarged intraabdominal lymph nodes were
observed. No lytic-destructive lesions were detected in bone structures. Vertebral corpus
heights are preserved. Thoracic kyphosis has increased. The neural foramina are open. In the
examination performed without contrast material, no pathological appearance was detected in
other organs included in the study area.

reports.report_text:
There are several nodules in both lungs, the largest of which is observed in the upper lobe of the
right lung. The described nodules have a ground glass-like appearance and tend to coalesce.
There are also emphysematous changes in both lungs. In addition, there are areas of linear
subsegmental atelectasis in both lungs and pleural thickening in the left hemithorax. No mass
was detected in the upper abdominal sections included in the examination. A few millimetric
nonspecific pulmonary nodules were observed in both lungs. There are no lymph nodes in
pathological size and appearance within the borders of non-contrast CT. No lytic or destructive
lesions were detected in bone structures within the study area.

reports.report_text:
There are consolidations in both lungs, more prominent on the right. The consolidations have a
ground glass appearance and tend to coalesce peripherally. There is also an increase in density
consistent with consolidation in the lower lobes of both lungs. No mass or infiltrative lesion was
detected within the borders of non-contrast CT. In addition, there are findings compatible with
Covid-19 pneumonia. Other viral pneumonias can be considered in the differential diagnosis.
Clinical and laboratory correlation is recommended.
